name: The Grafting Avenue
prompt: Make an inhabited avenue beneath joined fruit-tree canopies. Arborists bind grafts on raised platforms while greengrocers sort several kinds of fruit from a single spreading crown.

name: The Seed Bank District
prompt: Cluster seed-drying lofts around a cool underground archive. Show threshing screens, trays of coloured beans and a porter lowering sealed jars under the public square.

name: The Root Crossing
prompt: Bridge a sunken glass root gallery with narrow pedestrian streets. Gardeners guide exposed roots around a buried water main while people walk under the same trees above.

name: A Street for Rain
prompt: Turn a residential lane into a stepped chain of planted rain gardens. Show one roof discharging into a lily court and neighbours lifting a sluice toward a thirsty grove.

name: The Night Bloom Quarter
prompt: Give a row of conservatories folding shutters on tall runners. Gardeners shade one flowering house for night-blooming plants while the next glasshouse stands fully open to daylight.
